description: Permission Sentinel Knowledge Base - Maps Android permissions to sensitivity, purpose expectations, and explanations.

android.permission.INTERNET.label: Internet Access
android.permission.INTERNET.explanation: Allows the app to open network sockets and access the internet.
android.permission.INTERNET.data_exposed: Network traffic, potentially any data the app transmits
android.permission.INTERNET.notes: Very common permission. Expected for most apps that fetch data. Offline calculators typically don't need it.

android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.label: Precise Location (GPS)
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.explanation: Allows the app to access precise GPS-based location data.
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.data_exposed: Exact GPS coordinates, movement patterns, home/work locations
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.notes: Precise location is sensitive. Many apps only need coarse location or no location at all.
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.safer_alternative: Consider ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION if precise GPS is not essential.

android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.label: Approximate Location
android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.explanation: Allows the app to access approximate network-based location.
android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.notes: Less sensitive than fine location but still reveals general whereabouts.

android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.label: Background Location Access
android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.explanation: Allows the app to access location even when not in the foreground.
android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.data_exposed: Continuous location tracking, movement history, location patterns
android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOC.notes: Background location enables continuous tracking. Must have clear user-facing rationale such as continuous navigation or fitness tracking.

android.permission.CAMERA.label: Camera
android.permission.CAMERA.explanation: Allows the app to access the device camera to take photos or videos.
android.permission.CAMERA.data_exposed: Photos, videos, visual surroundings, potentially facial data
android.permission.CAMERA.notes: Camera access is sensitive. Expected for camera/photo apps and messaging with video calls.
android.permission.CAMERA.safer_alternative: Use system camera intent (ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE) if only capturing photos.

android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.label: Microphone / Record Audio
android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.explanation: Allows the app to record audio using the device microphone.
android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.notes: Microphone access can capture conversations. Expected for voice messaging, video calls, or voice recording apps.
android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.safer_alternative: Use speech recognition intents if only needed for voice input.

android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.label: Read Contacts
android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.explanation: Allows the app to read the user's contact list.
android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.data_exposed: Contact names, phone numbers, email addresses, social connections
android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.notes: Contact data reveals social graph. Expected mainly for messaging/communication apps.
android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.safer_alternative: Use contact picker intent for selecting individual contacts.

android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS.label: Write Contacts
android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS.explanation: Allows the app to modify the user's contact list.
android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS.data_exposed: Can modify or add contacts, potentially used for social engineering
android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS.notes: Writing contacts is rarely needed. Review carefully.
android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS.safer_alternative: Use INSERT intent to add individual contacts with user confirmation.

android.permission.READ_SMS.label: Read SMS Messages
android.permission.READ_SMS.explanation: Allows the app to read SMS messages stored on the device.
android.permission.READ_SMS.data_exposed: SMS messages including OTPs, verification codes, private conversations
android.permission.READ_SMS.notes: SMS access reveals private messages and OTP codes. Very sensitive. Only messaging apps typically need this.
android.permission.READ_SMS.safer_alternative: Use SMS Retriever API for OTP auto-fill.

android.permission.SEND_SMS.label: Send SMS Messages
android.permission.SEND_SMS.explanation: Allows the app to send SMS messages, potentially incurring charges.
android.permission.SEND_SMS.data_exposed: Can send messages on user's behalf, may incur costs
android.permission.SEND_SMS.notes: Sending SMS can incur charges and be used for premium-rate fraud. Very sensitive permission.
android.permission.SEND_SMS.safer_alternative: Use SMS intent to let user confirm and send manually.

android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS.label: Receive SMS Messages
android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS.explanation: Allows the app to receive and process incoming SMS messages.
android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS.data_exposed: Incoming SMS messages, OTPs, verification codes
android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS.notes: Receiving SMS is typically only needed by messaging apps or apps that auto-read OTPs.
android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS.safer_alternative: Use SMS Retriever API for OTP verification.

android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE.label: Read Phone State
android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE.explanation: Allows the app to read phone state including phone number, IMEI, and call status.
android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE.data_exposed: Phone number, device identifiers (IMEI), call state, SIM info
android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE.notes: Phone state includes device identifiers useful for tracking. Review whether the app needs this level of access.

android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.label: Read Call Log
android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.explanation: Allows the app to read the user's call history.
android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.data_exposed: Call history, call durations, contact frequency patterns
android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG.notes: Call logs reveal communication patterns. Very rarely needed outside of dialer/messaging apps.

android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.label: Read External Storage
android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.explanation: Allows the app to read files from shared/external storage.
android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.data_exposed: Photos, documents, downloads, and other files on shared storage
android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.notes: Broad storage access can expose personal files. Android 11+ scoped storage reduces this risk.
android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE.safer_alternative: Use Storage Access Framework or MediaStore API for scoped access.

android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.label: Write External Storage
android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.explanation: Allows the app to write files to shared/external storage.
android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.data_exposed: Can create/modify files on shared storage
android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.notes: Writing to storage is needed for saving files. Scoped storage is preferred on Android 10+.
android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAG.safer_alternative: Use app-specific directory or MediaStore API.

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.label: Read Media Images
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.explanation: Allows the app to read image files from shared storage (Android 13+).
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.data_exposed: Photos and images stored on the device
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.notes: Scoped media permission introduced in Android 13. More targeted than broad storage access.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES.safer_alternative: Use photo picker for selecting individual images.

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO.label: Read Media Videos
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO.explanation: Allows the app to read video files from shared storage (Android 13+).
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO.notes: Scoped media permission for videos. Less broad than full storage access.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO.safer_alternative: Use video picker for selecting individual videos.

android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.label: Read Media Audio
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.explanation: Allows the app to read audio files from shared storage (Android 13+).
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.data_exposed: Audio files and music stored on the device
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.notes: Scoped media permission for audio files.
android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO.safer_alternative: Use audio picker for selecting individual files.

android.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION.label: Activity Recognition
android.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION.explanation: Allows the app to recognize physical activities like walking, running, driving.
android.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION.data_exposed: Physical activity data, exercise patterns, movement type
android.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION.notes: Activity recognition is primarily useful for fitness and health apps.

android.permission.BODY_SENSORS.label: Body Sensors
android.permission.BODY_SENSORS.explanation: Allows the app to access body sensor data such as heart rate.
android.permission.BODY_SENSORS.data_exposed: Health data from body sensors (heart rate, etc.)
android.permission.BODY_SENSORS.notes: Body sensor data is health-related and sensitive.

android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE.label: Access WiFi State
android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE.explanation: Allows the app to view information about WiFi networks.
android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE.notes: Generally low-risk. Used to check connectivity status.

android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.label: Access Network State
android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.explanation: Allows the app to view the state of all networks.
android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.notes: Very common permission for checking connectivity. Low risk.

android.permission.VIBRATE.label: Vibrate
android.permission.VIBRATE.explanation: Allows the app to control the device vibrator.
android.permission.VIBRATE.notes: Low-risk permission used for haptic feedback and notifications.

android.permission.WAKE_LOCK.label: Wake Lock
android.permission.WAKE_LOCK.explanation: Allows the app to prevent the device from sleeping.
android.permission.WAKE_LOCK.notes: Used for keeping screen on or maintaining background processes. Can impact battery.

android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE.label: Run at Startup
android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE.explanation: Allows the app to start automatically when the device boots.
android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE.data_exposed: App runs in background from device start
android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETE.notes: Allows persistent background operation. Review whether auto-start is necessary.

android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE.label: Foreground Service
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE.explanation: Allows the app to run foreground services with a persistent notification.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE.data_exposed: App can run persistently in the background
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE.notes: Foreground services run persistently. Expected for navigation, music playback, and similar features.

android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.label: Post Notifications
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.explanation: Allows the app to post notifications (Android 13+).
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.data_exposed: Can show notifications to the user
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.notes: Required on Android 13+ for notifications. Generally low sensitivity.

android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC.label: Biometric Authentication
android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC.explanation: Allows the app to use biometric hardware for authentication.
android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC.data_exposed: Biometric authentication events (not raw biometric data)
android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC.notes: Used for secure authentication. Generally appropriate for security-sensitive apps.

android.permission.BLUETOOTH.label: Bluetooth
android.permission.BLUETOOTH.explanation: Allows the app to connect to paired Bluetooth devices.
android.permission.BLUETOOTH.notes: Bluetooth used for connecting to wearables, headphones, or IoT devices.

android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT.label: Bluetooth Connect (Android 12+)
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT.explanation: Allows the app to connect to paired Bluetooth devices on Android 12+.
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT.notes: Android 12+ Bluetooth permission. Needed for connecting to Bluetooth devices.

android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN.label: Bluetooth Scan (Android 12+)
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN.explanation: Allows the app to discover and scan for nearby Bluetooth devices on Android 12+.
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN.data_exposed: Nearby Bluetooth devices, potentially location via BLE beacons
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN.notes: Can be used for location tracking via BLE beacons. Review if scanning is necessary.

android.permission.NFC.label: NFC
android.permission.NFC.explanation: Allows the app to use Near Field Communication.
android.permission.NFC.data_exposed: NFC tag data, contactless payment interactions
android.permission.NFC.notes: NFC is used for contactless payments and tag reading.

android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA.label: Request Install Packages
android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA.explanation: Allows the app to request installation of other applications.
android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA.data_exposed: Can install new apps, potentially from untrusted sources
android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKA.notes: Very sensitive. Could be used to install malicious apps. Rarely needed outside app stores and browsers.

android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.label: Draw Over Other Apps
android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.explanation: Allows the app to draw overlays on top of other applications.
android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.data_exposed: Can overlay content on other apps, potential for UI deception
android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.notes: Overlay permission can be used for chat heads but also for clickjacking attacks. High risk.
android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.safer_alternative: Use notification bubbles instead of overlays where possible.

android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.label: Manage All Files
android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.explanation: Allows the app to access and manage all files on external storage.
android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.data_exposed: Complete access to all files on the device storage
android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.notes: Grants unrestricted file access. Very rarely needed. Google Play restricts this permission.
android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORA.safer_alternative: Use scoped storage, MediaStore API, or Storage Access Framework.

android.permission.READ_CALENDAR.label: Read Calendar
android.permission.READ_CALENDAR.explanation: Allows the app to read the user's calendar events.
android.permission.READ_CALENDAR.data_exposed: Calendar events, schedules, meeting details, attendees
android.permission.READ_CALENDAR.notes: Calendar data reveals schedules and social connections.
android.permission.READ_CALENDAR.safer_alternative: Use calendar intent for adding events without reading existing ones.

android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR.label: Write Calendar
android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR.explanation: Allows the app to modify the user's calendar events.
android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR.notes: Modifying calendar can disrupt user's schedule.
android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR.safer_alternative: Use calendar intent for adding events with user confirmation.

android.permission.ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK.label: Local Network Access
android.permission.ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK.explanation: Allows the app to discover and connect to devices on your local Wi-Fi or LAN network.
android.permission.ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK.data_exposed: Local IP addresses, connected smart home or LAN devices, local network services
android.permission.ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK.notes: Used for local device discovery (mDNS, SSDP, Chromecast, smart home devices).
android.permission.ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK.safer_alternative: Use Android CompanionDeviceManager if connecting to specific paired Bluetooth or Wi-Fi devices.

android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_.label: AdServices Advertising ID
android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_.explanation: Allows the app to access the Privacy Sandbox Advertising ID for analytics and ad attribution.
android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_.data_exposed: Advertising ID for cross-app measurement and attribution
android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_.notes: Privacy Sandbox replacement for standard Advertising ID on Android 13+. Used for privacy-preserving attribution.

android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS.label: Get Accounts
android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS.explanation: Allows access to the list of accounts in the Accounts Service.
android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS.data_exposed: User account names and registered emails on the device
android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS.notes: Used by apps for single sign-on (SSO) and account synchronization.
android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS.safer_alternative: Use Credential Manager API or Google Identity Services.

android.permission.MANAGE_ACCOUNTS.label: Manage Accounts
android.permission.MANAGE_ACCOUNTS.explanation: Allows the app to manage the list of accounts in the AccountManager.
android.permission.MANAGE_ACCOUNTS.data_exposed: Device account authentication tokens and account configurations

android.permission.USE_CREDENTIALS.label: Use Account Credentials
android.permission.USE_CREDENTIALS.explanation: Allows the app to request auth tokens from the AccountManager.
android.permission.USE_CREDENTIALS.data_exposed: Account authentication tokens for signed-in services
android.permission.USE_CREDENTIALS.notes: Used for authenticating signed-in user sessions.

android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.label: Schedule Exact Alarm
android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.explanation: Allows the app to schedule exact alarms for time-critical actions.
android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.data_exposed: Exact timing triggers and alarm execution
android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.notes: Used for precise reminders, alarms, and timers.
android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM.safer_alternative: Use WorkManager for non-exact background tasks.

android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM.label: Use Exact Alarm
android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM.explanation: Allows the app to use exact alarm alarms for clock and timer functions.
android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM.notes: Pre-granted permission for alarm clock and calendar apps.

combination_rules.name: Location + Contacts
combination_rules.explanation: This app requests both location data and contact access. These sensitive data categories together could allow correlating physical movements with social connections. Review whether both are core to the app's functionality.
combination_rules.confidence: heuristic: co-occurrence of sensitive data categories
combination_rules.recommendation: Verify that both location and contact access are essential features. Consider whether the app could function with only one of these permissions.

combination_rules.name: Microphone + Background Capability
combination_rules.explanation: This app requests microphone access along with background service capability. This combination could enable background audio recording. Review whether continuous or background audio recording is a declared and necessary feature.
combination_rules.recommendation: Confirm that background audio recording is an explicit, user-visible feature. If the app is a voice recorder or voice call app, this may be justified.

combination_rules.name: File Access + Internet
combination_rules.explanation: This app requests broad file/storage access combined with internet access. This combination means personal files could potentially be transmitted over the network. This does not prove any data exfiltration occurred—only that the technical capability exists.
combination_rules.confidence: heuristic: data access + network capability co-occurrence
combination_rules.recommendation: Review whether the app needs both broad file access and network connectivity. Consider whether scoped storage would suffice.

combination_rules.name: SMS + Contacts
combination_rules.explanation: This app requests both SMS access and contact access. Together, these could expose private communication content and the user's social network. Review whether both are essential to the app's declared purpose.
combination_rules.confidence: heuristic: private communication + social graph access
combination_rules.recommendation: Verify that SMS and contacts access are both core features. Consider using SMS Retriever API for OTP auto-fill and contact picker for individual contact selection.

combination_rules.name: Precise Location + Background Location
combination_rules.explanation: This app requests both precise GPS location and background location access. This combination enables continuous, precise tracking of the user's movements even when the app is not in use. Review whether continuous tracking is essential and user-controlled.
combination_rules.confidence: heuristic: continuous precise location tracking capability
combination_rules.recommendation: Confirm that continuous location tracking is an explicit, user-visible feature (e.g., turn-by-turn navigation, fitness route tracking). Ensure there is a clear way for users to stop tracking.

combination_rules.name: Camera + Microphone
combination_rules.explanation: This app requests both camera and microphone access. Together, these enable full audio-visual recording. This may be expected for video calling or recording apps but should be reviewed for other app categories.
combination_rules.recommendation: Verify that the app has a legitimate need for both camera and microphone (e.g., video calls, video recording). For apps that only need photos, microphone access is unexpected.
